source_text: Of all 100 samples, 99% had the kdr east (Vgsc_1014S) mutation and the remaining one had the kdr west (Vgsc_1014F) gene mutation... along with high frequency (99.14%) of the kdr east allele in the F1 progeny originating from Tulukuyi, Western Kenya.

Post bioassay, 50 resistant and 50 susceptible mosquitoes were subsequently screened for kdr East and West mutations... of the 100 selected for further processing, 99% were positive for kdr East and 1% for kdr West... and the remaining one had the kdr west (Vgsc_1014F) gene mutation.
